def now():
    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()


def meta(data):
    return {'bytes': len(data), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),
            'blob': hashlib.sha1(b'blob ' + str(len(data)).encode() + b'\0' + data).hexdigest()}


def sha(path):
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, 'sha256').hexdigest()


def save(name, value):
    with (RECORDS / name).open('x') as stream:
        json.dump(value, stream, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
        stream.write('\n')


def git(*args, cwd=REPO):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', '--no-optional-locks', *args], cwd=cwd)


def identity(cwd=REPO):
    sparse = Path(git('rev-parse', '--git-path', 'info/sparse-checkout', cwd=cwd).decode().strip())
    if not sparse.is_absolute():
        sparse = cwd / sparse
    return {'commit': git('rev-parse', 'HEAD', cwd=cwd).decode().strip(),
            'tree': git('rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}', cwd=cwd).decode().strip(),
            'status': git('status', '--porcelain=v1', '--untracked-files=all', cwd=cwd).decode(),
            'diff_sha256': hashlib.sha256(git('diff', '--binary', 'HEAD', '--', cwd=cwd)).hexdigest(),
            'cargo_lock_sha256': sha(cwd / 'codex-rs/Cargo.lock'),
            'sparse_path': str(sparse.resolve()), 'sparse_sha256': sha(sparse)}


def inventory():
    rows = []
    names = git('ls-files', '-z') + git('ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard', '-z')
    for raw in sorted(set(names.split(b'\0')) - {b''}):
        rel = os.fsdecode(raw)
        path = REPO / rel
        if not path.exists() and not path.is_symlink():
            rows.append({'path': rel, 'missing': True})
            continue
        data = os.fsencode(os.readlink(path)) if path.is_symlink() else path.read_bytes()
        mode = '120000' if path.is_symlink() else ('100755' if path.stat().st_mode & 0o111 else '100644')
        rows.append({'path': rel, 'mode': mode, **meta(data)})
    encoded = json.dumps(rows, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')).encode()
    return rows, encoded


def snapshot(label):
    rows, encoded = inventory()
    with gzip.open(RECORDS / (label + '.files.json.gz'), 'xb') as stream:
        stream.write(encoded)
    observed = {**identity(), 'files': len(rows), 'inventory_sha256': hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest()}
    save(label + '.json', observed)
    return observed, rows, encoded



def refuse_symlinks(path, require_leaf=True):
    for item in reversed(path.parents):
        value = item.lstat()
        assert stat.S_ISDIR(value.st_mode) and not stat.S_ISLNK(value.st_mode), str(item)
    if require_leaf:
        value = path.lstat()
        assert stat.S_ISREG(value.st_mode) and not stat.S_ISLNK(value.st_mode), str(path)
        assert value.st_nlink == 1 and value.st_uid == os.getuid(), str(path)


def shape(value):
    return (value.st_dev, value.st_ino, value.st_uid, value.st_gid,
            value.st_mode, value.st_nlink, value.st_size, value.st_mtime_ns, value.st_ctime_ns)


def require_source(observed):
    assert observed['commit'] == BASE and observed['tree'] == BASE_TREE and observed['status'] == '', observed
    assert observed['files'] == 14995 and observed['inventory_sha256'] == BASE_INVENTORY, observed
    assert observed['cargo_lock_sha256'] == LOCK, observed
    assert observed['diff_sha256'] == hashlib.sha256(b'').hexdigest(), observed


def read_pinned(path, size, digest):
    refuse_symlinks(path)
    before = path.lstat()
    assert before.st_size == size, str(path)
    descriptor = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    with os.fdopen(descriptor, 'rb') as stream:
        assert shape(os.fstat(stream.fileno())) == shape(before), str(path)
        actual = hashlib.file_digest(stream, 'sha256').hexdigest()
        after_fd = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
    after = path.lstat()
    assert shape(before) == shape(after_fd) == shape(after), str(path)
    assert actual == digest, str(path)
    return {'path': str(path), 'bytes': size, 'sha256': actual, 'stat': list(shape(after))}
